Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Mods: All Smartgun Link and Smart Rebuild Attachments

When your one-true-pairing isn’t limited to sentient organisms.

When firing a Twin-Linked weapon while wielding one or more additional Twin-Linked weapons, the user may fire all Twin-Linked weapons at the same target as a Linked Attack. All weapons must be fired in the same firing mode, and must all be Explosive or Non-Explosive (e.g., cannot mix a Grenade Launcher with a Heavy Pistol). The Linked Attack’s Check uses the highest DV between all fired weapons, and uses the Skill for which the user has the lowest Skill Level among all fired weapons. Each fired weapon expends the same amount of rounds they normally would in the used firing mode.

If the Linked Attack hits, the user rolls the highest source of damage between all fired weapons, and adds +1 to the Attack’s total damage (before any armor or multiplier) for each d6 the other fired weapon(s) would normally roll when dealing damage in that firing mode. For Autofire, the ‘highest source of damage’ is considered the fired weapon with the highest Autofire Rating.

EX: If making a Linked Single Shot Attack with a Heavy Pistol (3d6) and Assault Rifle (5d6) at a target 12m/yds away, the Attack Check uses the Rifle’s DV16. If it hits, the user rolls 5d6 damage and adds 3 to the total damage before armor (5d6+3).

Attachment slots: 0 (Weapon Mod)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Mod Catalog > Attachment Mods).
